findings.description: The KMS key does not have automatic key rotation enabled (enable_key_rotation is not set to true), which weakens cryptographic hygiene by not periodically rotating the underlying key material, increasing risk if the key is ever compromised.

No key policy is defined for the KMS key, which means it will use the default policy granting full access to the root account/IAM policies, potentially allowing overly broad access to the key without explicit least-privilege restrictions.
